new_claims.statement: For independent cap-one X,Y,Z and a 3x3 scalar coefficient matrix G with invertible indefinite endpoint pair E, D=|det E|, kappa=sigma_min(E), Delta=|det G|>0, arbitrary affine perturbations satisfy ||p_Q||_inf <= 8 sqrt(2) sqrt(D/(kappa Delta)) + 2/sqrt(D); arbitrary outside terms/couplings are allowed after conditioning outside original coordinates.

For three disjoint unit-projection banks whose active dependence factors through a scalar matrix G, the same indefinite endpoint geometry gives ||p_Q||_inf <=16 sqrt(2) sqrt(D/(kappa Delta))+4/sqrt(D).

A uniformly conditioned indefinite endpoint pair without third Schur-center curvature does not ensure bounded density: (X+Y)^2-Z^2 for independent cap-one uniforms has a logarithmically unbounded density at zero and coefficient spectrum {2,-1,0}; this is not a counterexample to the full three-large-eigenvalue conjecture.
